Train once per fold; score each fold once.

Holds the settings of Train > Cross-validate: the graph is trained once per fold with fresh weights and scored on the fold it did not see. Data passes through unchanged, so Train trains as usual; the fold table is the second output after a run.

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |

| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | The same data, for the rest of the graph |
| **Results** | Dataset | No | 1 | The last run: one row per fold (rows, scores) |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| folds | `folds` | Integer | `5` |   | The run | Folds, 2 to 20. |
| stratified | `stratified` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Keep each fold's class shares. |
| seed | `seed` | Integer | `42` |   | The run | Seed for the folds. |
| results_table | `results_table` | Text | `cross_validation_results` |   | The run | Name the last run's table is published under. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
